evals.name: configure-existing
evals.prompt: tenho um projeto laravel aqui em ./meu-projeto que acabei de criar, ainda tá cru. aplica o setup padrão nele: análise estática, code style, os scripts de qualidade, tudo. é um projeto interno, em inglês mesmo.
evals.expected_output: phpstan.neon + pint.json written, dev deps installed, composer scripts stan/pint/coverage/coverage-html/quality merged into composer.json without losing the existing ones, pt_BR NOT applied (user said English), composer stan and composer pint both run clean.
assertions: phpstan.neon exists in the project
pint.json exists in the project
composer scripts stan/pint/coverage/coverage-html/quality all present
Laravel's pre-existing composer scripts survived the merge
laravel/framework still installed (project not broken)
composer stan runs clean on the configured project
pt_BR was NOT applied (user asked for English / did not ask for it)
the coverage scripts run pest with XDEBUG_MODE=coverage and no -d pcov.enabled=1
the coverage scripts check for a coverage driver (@coverage-driver) before running pest

evals.name: deploy-only
evals.prompt: esse projeto aqui já tá configurado, só falta o deploy. adiciona o workflow do github actions pra mandar pra hospedagem compartilhada — no servidor a aplicação fica em app/projetos/loja.
evals.expected_output: .github/workflows/deploy.yml written with server-dir and the ssh 'cd' both pointing at app/projetos/loja/, no placeholders left, and nothing else in the project changed (no phpstan.neon/pint.json rewrite, no packages installed). The user is told which GitHub variables and secret to configure.
assertions: .github/workflows/deploy.yml exists in the project
the FTP action's server-dir is app/projetos/loja/
the ssh-action script cds into app/projetos/loja/
no __PLACEHOLDER__ tokens remain in the workflow
the workflow is valid YAML with a single job triggered on push to main
only the deploy step ran — no dev packages were installed and no other config file was rewritten
the answer names the required repo variables (FTP_HOST, FTP_USER) and secret (FTP_PASSWORD)

evals.name: coverage-no-driver
evals.prompt: rodei `composer coverage` no projeto em ./meu-projeto e ele sai com erro mesmo com todos os testes passando. aparece um WARN Failed to set "pcov.enabled=1" antes. o que tá acontecendo?
evals.expected_output: The diagnosis is the missing coverage driver: without pcov or xdebug nothing measures coverage, so the run dies on --min. The fix comes from the skill itself — the `coverage-driver` step (`setup.sh --only coverage-driver`) installs pcov/xdebug, or rebuilds the Sail image that lacks it (`sail build --no-cache`) — never another Composer package. If the project's scripts still carry the old `XDEBUG_MODE=off ... -d pcov.enabled=1` form, they are fixed by re-running the composer-scripts step rather than by hand-editing composer.json.
assertions: the answer names the missing coverage driver (pcov/xdebug) as the cause, not the tests and not the --min value itself
the answer does not propose installing a Composer package to fix it
the fix goes through the skill (the coverage-driver step), not a hand-written sequence of commands invented on the spot
a Sail rebuild (sail build --no-cache) is named when the project runs on Sail
if composer.json was changed, the coverage scripts came from the skill (XDEBUG_MODE=coverage, @coverage-driver guard, no -d pcov.enabled=1)
the project's tests still pass afterwards

evals.name: fresh-app-coverage-threshold
evals.prompt: cria um projeto laravel novo chamado loja com o setup padrão. é em inglês. e deixa o `composer coverage` passando de primeira, ainda não tenho testes escritos.
evals.expected_output: The app is scaffolded with the full toolchain and the coverage threshold is set through the skill (COVERAGE_MIN=0, or another value the user can raise later) instead of hand-editing composer.json — so `composer coverage` passes on a project whose suite is still just the example tests. The user is told to raise the number once there is a suite.
assertions: project directory named "loja" was created
composer scripts stan/pint/coverage/coverage-html/quality all present
the coverage scripts run pest with XDEBUG_MODE=coverage and no -d pcov.enabled=1
the coverage scripts check for a coverage driver (@coverage-driver) before running pest
the --min in the coverage scripts is a value the fresh project can actually meet
the threshold was set via the skill (COVERAGE_MIN), not by hand-editing composer.json after the run
the answer tells the user to raise the threshold once a suite exists
pt_BR was NOT applied (user asked for English)
